info.title: World Bank Indicators API
info.description:
The World Bank Indicators API provides open access to the World Bank's global development and macroeconomic statistics — over 29,000 time-series indicators (GDP, inflation, unemployment, government debt, trade, population, and more) for every country and aggregate region. Data is annual and historical. No authentication is required.

Response shape: every endpoint returns a JSON array of exactly two elements. Element [0] is a pagination metadata object ({page, pages, per_page, total, sourceid, lastupdated}); element [1] is the array of data rows. Always pass `format=json` (the API defaults to XML otherwise).

tags.name: Indicators
tags.description: Indicator definitions and per-country indicator time series

get.summary: Get an indicator time series for one or more countries
get.description: Returns the annual historical time series for the given indicator and country. `countryCode` accepts a single ISO2/ISO3 code (e.g. FR / FRA), a semicolon-separated list (e.g. FR;DE;IT), or 'all'. This is the primary data endpoint.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO2 or ISO3 country code, a semicolon-separated list of codes, or 'all'. Example: FR, FRA, or FR;DE;IT.

parameters.name: indicator
parameters.description: World Bank indicator code. Example: NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP, current US$), FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG (inflation, consumer prices, annual %).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter by year or a year range using a colon. Example: 2020 or 2010:2025.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Numeric source database id (e.g. 2 = World Development Indicators). Use when an indicator exists in multiple sources.

200.description: A two-element array: [pagination metadata, array of observation rows].

400.description: Bad request (invalid parameter). Note: the World Bank API frequently returns HTTP 200 with an error object in element [0] rather than a 4xx status.

401.description: Unauthorized (not applicable — this API requires no authentication).

get.summary: List all countries and aggregate regions
get.description: Returns the full list of countries and regional/income aggregates with metadata (region, income level, capital, coordinates).

200.description: A two-element array: [pagination metadata, array of country rows].

get.summary: Get metadata for a specific country
get.description: Returns metadata for a single country or a semicolon-separated list: region, income level, lending type, capital city, and coordinates.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO2 or ISO3 country code, or a semicolon-separated list. Example: FR or FRA.

200.description: A two-element array: [pagination metadata, array of country rows].

get.description: Returns the catalog of all World Bank indicators (~29,000+). Each entry includes the indicator code, name, unit, source, and a source note describing the metric. Use per_page/page to page through the large catalog.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Restrict to indicators from a specific numeric source database id.

200.description: A two-element array: [pagination metadata, array of indicator definitions].

get.summary: Get the definition of a specific indicator
get.description: Returns the definition of a single indicator: code, name, unit, source, source note, and source organization.

parameters.name: indicator
parameters.description: World Bank indicator code. Example: FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.

200.description: A two-element array: [pagination metadata, array with the indicator definition].

format.name: format
format.description: Response format. Pass 'json' — the API defaults to XML if omitted.

PaginationMeta.description: Element [0] of every response: pagination and source metadata.

sourceid.description: Numeric id of the source database.

lastupdated.description: Date the source data was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

CodeValue.description: A reusable {id, value} pair used for indicator and country references.

Observation.description: A single indicator observation row for a country and year.

value.description: The observed value; null when unavailable.

Country.description: A country or aggregate region record.

CodeValueRegion.description: A {id, iso2code, value} classification reference (region, income level, lending type).

IndicatorDataResponse.description: Two-element array: [PaginationMeta, array of Observation rows].

CountryListResponse.description: Two-element array: [PaginationMeta, array of Country rows].

IndicatorListResponse.description: Two-element array: [PaginationMeta, array of IndicatorDefinition rows].

ErrorResponse.description: World Bank error payload. Note the API often returns this inside element [0] of a 200 response rather than with a 4xx status.
